title: BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs
title_zh: BenchChecker：评估大型语言模型（LLM）在漏洞修复基准测试中的可信度

paragraphs.en: BenchChecker 是一个评估大型语言模型在漏洞修复基准测试中可信度的框架，通过检测数据污染来改进评估结果。 While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCoder2-15B, and CodeGen2-16B trained on The Stack v2 demonstrate that BenchChecker achieves robust detection with AUC scores around 0.9 across six benchmarks. Furthermore, applying BenchChecker to SWE-bench Verified and Multi-SWE-bench reveals that filtering contaminated samples reduces the reported resolution rates of most LLMs by more than 20% relative to the original rates on medium-difficulty tasks.
paragraphs.zh: BenchChecker 是一个用于评估大型语言模型在漏洞修复基准测试中可信度的框架，通过检测数据污染来改进评估结果。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有的基准测试存在数据污染问题：测试样本出现在训练集中，从而人为夸大了模型性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了 BenchChecker——一个兼容开源和闭源模型的框架，能够通过检测此类污染来实现更可信的评估。BenchChecker 基于以下观察：持久性补丁很可能保留在用于训练的近期代码库快照中。因此，它采用了一种基于数字取证的双阶段检测流程，仅使用模型生成的文本输出以及公开代码库的历史记录。第一阶段通过向模型输入代码前缀来探测训练数据中的代码库存在性；第二阶段则通过相似性对齐和测试套件验证，检测补丁是否存在以确认其持久性。在基于 The Stack v2 训练的 StarCoder-15B、StarCoder2-15B 和 CodeGen2-16B 模型上进行的评估表明，BenchChecker 在六个基准测试中均实现了约 0.9 的 AUC 分数，展现出强大的检测能力。此外，将 BenchChecker 应用于 SWE-bench Verified 和 Multi-SWE-bench 后发现，过滤掉受污染样本后，大多数 LLM 在中难度任务上的报告修复率较原始数据下降了超过 20%。
